correctness.rationale: Scott continuity gives monotonicity. For a nested chain of positive diagrams, endpoint E0-equivalence means their nested output sets differ by finitely many points; every intermediate output therefore differs from the lower endpoint by finitely many points. This contradicts reduction when the endpoints are isomorphic but the middle type is not. The equivalence-structure construction explicitly preserves and reflects the equivalence relation on each selected substructure.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies a structural obstruction to a natural descriptive-set-theoretic characterization of positive-data learning. It rules out a direct Scott-continuous E0 reduction even for a canonical TxtEx-complete family, clarifying that the full-diagram Cantor-topology theorem cannot be transferred unchanged to positive diagrams with the Scott topology.
